slides.texte_overlay:
By age 30 you should be smart
enough to realize these

Being busy is not
the same as being productive.

The people who clap for you
in private are the real ones.

Every yes to something
is a no to something else.

Your body is the only place
you have to live.

Not every message
needs an answer tonight.

The smartest people never
stop being students.
slides.texte_sophia:
The smartest people never
stop being students.
I learn daily on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
Your parents did their best
with what they knew.

Nobody is coming to save you.
That's good news.
